pageDescription: Unlock powerful security features by connecting to Bulwrk Cloud
pageDescriptionLinked: Manage your cloud connection and device settings
heroDescription: Link this device to Bulwrk Cloud for real-time threat monitoring, AI-powered safety analysis, vulnerability scanning, and a single dashboard to manage every device from anywhere. Plans start at just $5/month — cancel anytime, no commitment.
localFeaturesSubtitle: These features activate directly in your Bulwrk app once linked
featureThreatMonitorDesc: Tracks and alerts you if your computer communicates with ransomware command servers, criminal infrastructure, botnets, or other known-malicious endpoints in real time.
featureVulnerabilityDesc: Scans every installed application against a live database of known security vulnerabilities. Shows severity, affected versions, and available fixes.
featureAiSafetyDesc: AI analyzes every startup program and installed application, rating each on a 1-10 safety scale with detailed explanations. Know exactly what's running on your system.
featureBreachMonitorDesc: Add the email addresses you care about and Bulwrk checks them against known data breaches — showing which sites leaked, what data was exposed, and how many accounts were affected. Get alerted the moment your details appear in a new breach, and mark each one reviewed.
featureHealthReportsDesc: Automated posture checks covering antivirus, firewall, encryption, Windows Update, password policy, and more — sent to the dashboard every 30 minutes.
localFeaturesNote: Features marked Basic or Pro unlock on that plan or higher. Everything else is included on every plan.
upgradeCalloutTitle: Even on one device, Pro unlocks more
upgradeCalloutDesc: Basic gives you dashboards, alerts, compliance, AI safety analysis, and breach monitoring. Upgrading to Pro adds threat monitoring, vulnerability scanning, and automated remediation — features that protect you locally, not just in the cloud.
cloudFeaturesSubtitle: Manage and monitor all your devices from your Bulwrk cloud dashboard
featureRemoteDesc: Trigger scans, cleaning, software updates, and power control on any linked device from the web dashboard — no physical access needed.
featureTelemetryDesc: Real-time CPU, memory, disk, and network stats with historical trends. Monitor system health across your entire fleet at a glance.
featureComplianceDesc: Automated security posture analysis covering antivirus, firewall, encryption, updates, and password policy. Build custom compliance rules.
featureAlertsDesc: Configurable notifications for threats, compliance drift, system offline events, and new vulnerabilities. Integrate with email, Slack, and webhooks.
planProFeature1: Everything in Basic, including email breach monitoring
connectDescription: Create an account or paste your API key to link this device.
alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Paste your API key below.
telemetryDisclaimer: Only CPU & memory usage, disk space, network stats, uptime, and periodic health reports ({{registryExtra}}updates, privacy, malware). No file paths or personal data.
linkFailedDefaultDesc: Check your API key and try again
linkFailedConnectionDesc: Could not connect to cloud server
reconnectFailedDesc: Check your network connection and try again
shareDiskHealthDesc: Include disk SMART data in telemetry
threatMonitorDesc: Scan connections against known-malicious IPs and domains
threatListDescWaiting: Waiting for cloud to push a threat list
cveMonitorDesc: Scan installed software for known security vulnerabilities
remotePowerDesc: Allow cloud to shutdown or restart this device
remoteCleanupDescWindows: Allow cloud to delete files, remove bloatware, and fix registry
remoteCleanupDescOther: Allow cloud to delete files and perform cleanup
remoteInstallsDescWindows: Allow cloud to install software, driver, and Windows updates
remoteInstallsDescOther: Allow cloud to install software and system updates
remoteConfigDesc: Allow cloud to toggle startup items, services, and privacy settings
telemetryIntervalDesc: How often system stats are sent
pairingDescription: Enroll with a short-lived pairing code. This device generates its own Ed25519 key pair — no shared API key. The agent then polls for server-signed, allowlisted remote commands.
pairingWizardTitle: Add this device to your family
pairingWizardSubtitle: A short guided setup — no shared passwords, just a one-time pairing code.
pairingWizardStepIntroBody: Parents mint a code on the control plane. This device uses it once to enroll, then checks in with heartbeats.
pairingWizardStepIntroBullet1: Start the control plane (or use your Bulwrk cloud host).
pairingWizardStepIntroBullet2: Mint a short-lived pairing code for this device.
pairingWizardStepIntroBullet3: Enter the code here — Bulwrk creates a unique key for this device.
pairingWizardStepCodeBody: Codes are short-lived. Paste the code from your parent dashboard or control plane.
pairingWizardStepEnrollBody: Ready when you are. Enrollment creates keys on this device and registers it with the control plane.
pairingWizardStepEnrollWorking: Enrolling… hang tight while we register this device.
pairingWizardStepDoneBody: This device is enrolled. Request a health or malware scan from the parent panel below.
pairingWizardEnrolledDesc: Heartbeats and remote commands are active for this device.
pairingWizardFirstScanHint: Scroll to Parent controls below and request a Health or Malware scan for this device.
pairingHint: Create a code with POST /v1/pairing-codes on the control plane (npm run cloud:dev), then paste it here.
pairingFailedDefaultDesc: Check the pairing code and control plane URL
pairingFailedConnectionDesc: Could not reach the control plane
parentDescription: Parent control plane: mint pairing codes, isolate a kid’s TV, push DNS blocklists, and watch live network events.
parentNoDevices: No enrolled devices yet. Create a pairing code and enroll a TV or desktop agent.
parentNoFindings: Request inventory or run a scan from an enrolled device — results show up here with plain-language next steps.
parentInventoryQueuedToast: REQUEST_INVENTORY queued — agent will sync apps + findings
parentFeedsQueuedToast: UPDATE_THREAT_FEEDS queued — agent will sync URLhaus + optional domains
parentQuarantinePath: File path to quarantine (allowed dirs only)
parentQuarantinePathRequired: Enter a file path to quarantine
parentQuarantineQueuedToast: QUARANTINE_FILE queued — agent will move the file if allowed
parentScanQueuedToast: Scan queued — agent will post findings on next poll
parentTokenPlaceholder: Dashboard token (Bearer) — auto-filled via local bootstrap
parentTokenHint: Dashboard reads and writes require Authorization: Bearer. Local cloud:dev exposes GET /v1/dashboard-bootstrap; production sets DASHBOARD_TOKEN.
parentBreachHint: Stub mode without HIBP_API_KEY — use pwned@… or *@hibp-test.bulwrk.local for fixture hits
breachWizardConfirmBody: Enter a household email to check against known public breaches.
breachWizardConfirmHint: Only this address is looked up — not mailbox contents. You can remove the monitor anytime.
breachWizardDoneBody: The email is monitored. Review any open breaches, then rotate passwords on affected sites.
isolateWizardConfirmBody: Isolate {{name}} now? Most internet destinations will stop resolving until you clear isolation.
isolateWizardConfirmWarn: This is reversible. Heartbeats and parent commands continue so you can undo remotely.
isolateWizardDoneBody: Isolation was queued for this device. Watch heartbeats and network events. On Android TV, approve VPN/DNS Guard if prompted.
isolateWizardClearConfirmBody: Clear isolation for {{name}} and restore normal DNS policy?
isolateWizardClearDoneBody: Clear isolation was queued. Run a quick health or malware scan if you want extra reassurance.
